critical_failures.finding: New tailored welts detach from the authored pillow/cart-mattress surface beyond the prescribed 5 mm gap tolerance. The registry selects one nearest vertex for a joined multi-part group, so nearby stitch geometry can pass while substantial welt sections float.

critical_failures.interpretation: Welts have 1.5 mm radius (3 mm diameter). Even subtracting the full tube diameter from the maximum measured surface distance leaves more than 5 mm of separation on these five groups. This is a geometry/contact defect, not just a missing test.
critical_failures.repair_target: Fit welt centre lines to the actual final mesh or remove/rebuild floating welt runs. Register explicit witnesses on each welt run and at the worst end/corner locations instead of the globally nearest group vertex. Repeat the support checks and affected views.

remaining_defects.finding: Pre-revision OCRU pillow, recovery pillow and berth-pad seams remain alongside new tailored seams; portions are embedded roughly 7.8–9.9 mm into the final reshaped upholstery. This is obsolete duplicate construction requiring review after the shape replacement.

remaining_defects.repair_target: Remove or fit superseded seam runs; retain one deliberate sewn construction per edge.

remaining_defects.finding: Dated OCRU maintenance card contains eight degenerate mesh faces and eight zero-area MED_Physical_1m UV faces. The UV contract records the failure but asserts only finite coordinates; the numerical verifier does not fail zero-area geometry or UVs.
remaining_defects.repair_target: Remove/rebuild the collapsed faces introduced by skin projection and fail unintentional zero-area faces in verification.

verified_passes.layout_caveat: Inherited equipment, room planes and bounds retain baseline matrices/dimensions except the declared small dressing/access poses; existing interface source/provenance files were not mutated. Objective clearance test covers the reserved lane, not every object-pair collision.

packed_texture_portability.notes: Packed plaster maps load despite unavailable recorded disk paths. Complete overhaul file also requires its 25 linked libraries; portability here means the existing repository/dependency layout, not a single standalone file.

map_semantics.poster: sRGB clinical-propaganda image feeds Base Color and uses Printed artwork, which remains the render UV despite MED_Physical_1m being the editing-active layer.
map_semantics.bottle_labels: sRGB clinical-labels image feeds Base Color through explicit Clinical_Label UV; other non-label faces in that joined group may have zero label-UV area intentionally.
map_semantics.numeric_maps: Packed plaster roughness and height maps use Non-Color; height remains Bump, not tangent-normal input.
map_semantics.physical_named_uv: MED_Physical_1m exists on all 159 targeted meshes, with finite coordinates; the maintenance-card exception has eight zero-area faces.

new_shape_checks.load_columns: Both reshaped lift casings overlap their retained bolt flanges and retain their baseline bounds; no floating foot was established. Their nearest-distance check to chamber pan alone is not the correct support test.

verified_passes.body_bag_note: Closed folded bag retained beneath berth; four explicit note corners are included in the reproduced support report. No anatomy or open body-bag mesh was introduced by the reviewed code.

performance_context.notes: Approximately 3.2 times the baseline, largely upholstery/wall subdivision and dressing. No per-room numeric budget or measured engine draw-call/performance result was established in this critique.

limitations: No new authored build/rebuild was executed because the review is read-only; reproducible cold open and the existing validator were independently exercised.
No exhaustive all-pairs intersection audit, engine export or Unity behavior test was run.
Current full render batch was still in progress; this grade is technical and does not claim visual approval, checker coverage of every side or a cold/hot pixel comparison for this SHA.
The two spot energies are 35 W and 240 W. Exact count is verified; whether both read as dim requires the lighting/pixel critic.
Interface preservation is supported by baseline matrix/dimension checks, protected source hashes and unchanged contract files; no assembled-map promotion is authorized or performed.
